entries.description: Ask a question about a repository and get the relevant files and source excerpts. Uses your own Jev provider key.
For macOS: runs one short browser task in Chrome or Farero's browser. Jev picks each step; the goal, supplied values and page text go to TypeSafe on your key.
A small code review panel with author-defined roles and a Workflow template that starts only when you choose it.
Lauren Tan's pstack agent workflows: poteto-mode and its playbooks, skills to design, review, verify and explain code, 24 engineering principles, and roles for its helpers.

Garry Tan's gstack skills for Farero: the CEO, design, engineering and developer-experience plan reviews and the autoplan chain, pre-landing code review, ship, QA and design and documentation workflows, with roles and Workflow templates. Upstream text is unchanged; gstack's programs and browser daemon are left out.
